# Evidence review for the three-session assessment

Review date: 2026-10-25. This is a targeted, reproducible scoping review, not a systematic review or a validity finding for this product. Sources below are primary research or source-owner guidance. The linked abstracts/guidance were checked on the review date; full-text methods, populations and risk of bias must be extracted before quantitative synthesis. Search strings and exclusions are recorded at the end.

## What existing research can and cannot support

| Evidence | Observed result or method | Relevance and limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Sackett et al., 2022](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34968080/) | Reanalysis found earlier range-restriction corrections could overstate selection validities; revised mean estimates fell by roughly .10-.20 and structured interviews ranked highest in that synthesis. | Use current, conservative baselines and uncorrected operational estimates. A general interview result is not a three-answer engineering result. |
| [OPM structured-interview guidance](https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/assessment-and-selection/other-assessment-methods/structured-interviews/) | Job analysis, consistent questions/probes and anchored scoring are core design features. | Use a common administration and anchored rubrics; still test this specific instrument and role. |
| [ETS performance-assessment comparability](https://www.ets.org/Media/Research/pdf/psychometric_considerations_white_paper.pdf) | Task and rater variation can be large; generalizability designs separate their contributions. | One case per construct may yield a large person-by-case error. A rater agreement number alone is inadequate. |
| [Wingate et al., 2025](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/ijsa.12494) | Meta-analysis found targeted interview ratings related more to aligned work criteria than misaligned ones, yet ratings of distinct constructs did not cleanly separate within interviews. | Test both intended transfer and a general interview-performance/halo factor across our three sessions. |
| [Creativity/divergent-thinking meta-analysis](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8167550/) | Fluency, originality/quality and composites behave differently; fluency can contaminate originality scores. | Session 1 must judge the quality of a selected developed solution separately from quantity of ideas. Divergent thinking is not identical to engineering creativity. |
| [Rater-effects study in divergent thinking](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12194098/) | Open-response originality judgments are sensitive to rater behavior; item-response approaches can model rater effects. | Calibrate experts and estimate severity instead of treating adjudicated agreement as ground truth. |
| [CMU SEI ATAM](https://www.sei.cmu.edu/library/architecture-tradeoff-analysis-method-collection/) | Architecture evaluation links business goals to quality-attribute scenarios, risks and tradeoffs. | Basis for Session 2 content and rubric, but ATAM is a multi-day architecture review, not evidence that ten-minute narration predicts design quality. |
| [Google design-review study](https://research.google/pubs/improving-design-reviews-at-google/) | Real design reviews examine viability and inconsistency; the study concerns review workflow and latency. | Supports choosing design artifacts as a job-relevant criterion, not a validity coefficient for our case. |
| [Ford et al., 2017](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/publication/the-tech-talk-balance-what-technical-interviewers-expect-from-technical-candidates/) | Qualitative analysis of 70 technical-interview evaluations from nine software companies found variable interviewer expectations about walkthrough, experience and conversation. | Anchor technical scoring and disclose what is assessed; the mock-interview sample does not establish prediction. |
| [Behroozi et al., 2020](https://doi.org/10.1145/3368089.3409712) | Randomized study of 48 CS students found markedly lower whiteboard performance when observed than when working privately. | Test pressure/mode as a rival; student coding tasks are not asynchronous spoken architecture cases. |
| [McDaniel et al., 2007](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/j.1744-6570.2007.00065.x) | SJT best-action and likely-action instructions changed the constructs associated with scores. | Session 3 must specify which question it asks and test instruction effects rather than blending the two. |
| [Lievens et al., 2026](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42804245/) | Meta-analysis of 457 samples found SJT prediction in several outcome settings and examined constructed-response and webcam variants; applicant setting moderated validity. | Strong reason to test a work-related constructed-response comparator; no support for our exact game, rubric, population or one-case reliability. |
| [MacIntosh et al., 2026](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42242715/) | In health-profession constructed-response SJTs, more congruent outcomes showed stronger associations; overall evidence had moderate risk of bias. | Match Session 3's criterion to actual coordination, not a vague global performance rating; medicine does not transfer automatically to engineering. |
| [Voors et al., 2012](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S016517651100396X) and [Levitt & List, 2007](https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257/jep.21.2.153) | A public-goods lab choice did not meaningfully correlate with a field intervention in one study; a broader review explains why setting and scrutiny alter behavior. | Treat a pure prisoner's-dilemma choice as an experimental contrast, not as the primary job proxy. These studies do not prove all games fail. |
| [Koenecke et al., 2020](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32205437/) | Five speech systems showed different error rates across the studied speaker groups. | Measure the actual ASR stack and score impact by response mode and relevant groups; their historical error rates are not ours. |
| [ETS constructed-response scoring practices](https://www.ets.org/pdfs/about/cr_best_practices.pdf) | Automated-only scoring requires its own validity argument and atypical-response checks; human sampling remains useful. | Human agreement is only one gate. Keep evidence extraction, rater calibration, transfer and consequential error distinct. |

## Synthesis by session

### Session 1: creativity, analysis, ingenuity

Open-ended idea quantity, unusualness and useful originality are different variables. A fixed riddle with a canonical trick samples recognition and exposure; a constrained invention plus reveal can sample representation change. Both must be compared with independent engineering work. The **primary construct claim** is quality of creative reasoning under constraints, not a stable general creativity trait. Key unproven link: whether one ten-minute case captures enough person variance to generalize beyond its family. See the [Session 1 protocol](session-1-creativity.md).

### Session 2: technical/product design

Scenario-based architecture review has strong face and content relevance when anchored to a role. The unproven link is from short speech to implementation, design-review and operating judgment. A design can sound coherent while omitting data migrations, failure paths or costs. The criterion must be a separate artifact scored without knowing the interview result. See the [Session 2 protocol](session-2-technical-design.md).

### Session 3: cooperation and communication

The SJT literature provides a closer measurement family than a pure game. Instruction framing changes meaning: recognizing a good response, claiming likely behavior, and cooperating in an interaction are separate observations. Game studies give competing evidence about transfer and show setting effects. The experiment must compare these variants against observed coordination and an appropriately matched future criterion. See the [Session 3 protocol](session-3-cooperation.md).

## Gaps the existing literature leaves for this product

1. No located study validates **this exact three-by-ten-minute, AI-transcribed set** for software engineers. Broad meta-analytic estimates are priors for planning, not plug-in performance claims.
2. A single prompt per construct confounds person ability with prompt fit. The case-bank design must estimate how many independent cases would be needed, and the product must be willing to abandon the three-session limit if precision fails.
3. The target is underspecified until role, seniority, work context and criterion horizon are fixed. A score cannot mean the same thing for a junior web developer and a principal distributed-systems engineer without evidence.
4. Spoken-only response adds language, disability, stress, device and ASR pathways. Accommodations and alternate modes need construct-equivalence tests, not merely availability.
5. The feedback challenge recruits self-selected enthusiasts. Its reliability and usability data do not establish applicant-pool prediction or employer selection utility.
6. “Best engineers” depends on an outcome definition, capacity, time horizon and opportunity to perform. Supervisor ratings alone risk halo, team assignment and visibility bias; retained employees alone produce selective labels.
7. If questions are generated or models are updated continuously, case difficulty, item leakage and score scale drift can invalidate comparisons across cohorts. Freeze forms and models for each study; bridge versions experimentally.

## Search trace and next review pass

Searches on 2026-10-25: `personnel selection validity range restriction 2022`, `performance assessment task rater generalizability ETS`, `divergent thinking originality fluency meta analysis`, `architecture tradeoff analysis quality attribute SEI`, `situational judgment response instruction meta analysis`, `constructed response SJT validity 2026`, `prisoner's dilemma lab field transfer`, `ASR racial disparities 2020`, `ETS automated constructed response scoring`, `software engineering technical interview empirical`, `technical interview stress randomized`. Included primary research, primary institutional methods and official guidance. Excluded marketing-only validity coefficients, general news, Wikipedia, non-engineering effects presented as direct transfer, and unverified AI-hiring claims. Before a formal literature review, search PsycINFO, Scopus/Web of Science, ACM DL and IEEE Xplore; dual-screen titles/full text, extract samples and effect estimates, assess risk of bias, and retain conflicting/null studies in a dated evidence ledger.
